title: Which Way the Tune Goes
description: Hear whether a melody climbs, falls or stays put. It's the first step to playing tunes by ear.

steps.title: Up, down or nowhere
steps.description:
A melody can only do three things from one note to the next: go up, go down, or stay on the same note. Before you can work out a tune by ear, you need to hear which of those it's doing.

It can help to trace the line in the air with your hand while you listen.

steps.title: Which way?
steps.description: Listen to this short melody. Is it going up, coming down, or staying in one place?

steps.title: Which way now?
steps.description: Here's another one. Which direction is it heading?

steps.title: And this one?
steps.description: Listen closely. What is this melody doing?

steps.title: Two directions
steps.description: This melody changes direction partway through. What shape does it make overall?
steps.hint: Listen to where the middle note sits compared to the first and last.

steps.title: What shape?
steps.description: Last one. Trace it with your hand. What shape is it?
